heading: Event staff
intro: Give a registered BiletFlow user access to this event only. Check-in staff sign in to the mobile app to scan tickets. Support agents can answer and be assigned this event's support cases.
accountNote: The person must already have an account. Ask them to register first if the email is not found.
invalidEmail: Enter the email address of a registered account.

notices.checkInAdded: {name} can now check in attendees for this event in the BiletFlow mobile app.
notices.supportAdded: {name} can now handle and be assigned this event's support cases.
notices.supportRemoved: {name} no longer handles support. Their open cases were unassigned.
